Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the buffer between items, the items a run-of-show needs, the overtime limit and the minutes that count as late.
Fill Events first: date, venue, lead and the time guests leave. The days to go, the run-of-show state, overdue milestones and the curfew check fill in by themselves.
Build each run-of-show on Run-of-show (the event timeline): one row per item in time order. Use Run-of-show Templates and the Run-of-show Builder to start from ten steps.
Keep Planning Milestones current. Overdue and due soon milestones are flagged and the Milestone Dates calculator counts the dates back from the event date.
Enter every vendor on Vendor Arrivals with the planned arrival and the window for arrival and set-up (load-in). Keep Venue Access up to date with the curfew and the load-out deadline.
Plan the day on Day-of Roster, Contact Sheet, Packing List, Floor Plan Notes, Sound and Light Cues, Programme and Speeches, Catering Service and Transport Timetable.
Write the weather risks and the backup plans on Weather Plans and check Emergency Kit every quarter.
On the day, record each vendor on Vendor Check-in, each problem on Issues Log and each moment on Photo Shot List.
After the event, write the Post-event Debrief. Open follow-ups and vendors to rebook are flagged.

Use the 14 calculators before and on the day: run-of-show times, gaps, load-in, set-up time, crew size, catering timing, speeches, sunset, lateness cost, shuttles, milestone dates, curfew, cash and a what-if grid.
Read Day-of Dashboard and Charts every week: milestones, arrivals, overtime, issues and debrief scores.
